name: E.Leclerc
verdict: France's cooperative of independent E.Leclerc merchant-owners ('une coopérative de commerçants rassemblés sous une même enseigne'), founded by Édouard Leclerc at Landerneau in 1949. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: cooperative of independent merchant-owners (member ownership, like a mutual — the DEVK precedent); its members are thousands of private shop owners, so no state or fund stake can exist → none.
